$comment: Voiced version of chat-events-raids: the streamer tells the story (voice-over: Fish Official voices through Drama 3 on OpenRouter, directed with [bracket] tags; render with --allow-paid-tts and OPENROUTER_API_KEY) and the captions carry the same words. Same facts: incoming raid -> the bot posts the raid message as a purple Twitch announcement and sends a Twitch shoutout (shoutout.command.ts; 120 s cooldown, raids under minViewers 2 skipped). English uses the signup default raid message (utils/eventsub.ts); Spanish channels write their own. Raider name is spoken as 'Cozy Cactus' and the brand as 'Dom Dima Bot' so the voice says them right.

title.es: Rankeds con calma, ven a pasar el rato
Me cayó un raid *a media partida*

text.en: [excited, a little out of breath] Okay okay, so I just got raided [laughs] right in the middle of a round!
text.es: [excited, a little out of breath] ¡Bueno, bueno, me acaba de caer un raid [laughs] justo a media partida!
Me cayó un raid *a media partida*
¡cozy_cactus llegó en raid con 42 personas! Bienvenidos todos 🌵

text.en: [amazed] And before I could even say a word, my bot already welcomed everyone in chat,
text.es: [amazed] Y antes de que pudiera decir algo, mi bot ya les había dado la bienvenida en el chat,
Mi bot *les dio la bienvenida* al instante

text.en: [grinning] and gave Cozy Cactus a shoutout, so my chat can go follow them!
text.es: [grinning] y le dio shoutout a Cozy Cactus, ¡para que mi chat lo vaya a seguir!

text.en: [relaxed, happy] So when the round's over, I just get to say hi to everyone. [chuckles]
text.es: [relaxed, happy] Así, cuando termina la ronda, nada más saludo a todos. [chuckles]

text.en: After the round, *I just say hi*
[playful, a bit proud] It's Dom Dima Bot, by the way.
text.es: [playful, a bit proud] Es Dom Dima Bot, por cierto.
